plan.notes: Source: official FMCC catalog PDF served at fmcc.edu (2026-2027 cover; Academic Calendar 2026-2027 inside), Computer Science (A.S.), APC 0532, page 111. Program page: https://fmcc.edu/computers-technology/computer-science-as (page still cites the 2025-2026 catalog and says '61 Credits'; the live 2026-2027 catalog is authoritative). Transcription: downloaded the official PDF 2026-09-30 and extracted text with pdftotext; reconstructed the two-column term layout and verified every semester against the catalog's own printed term totals (Fall Y1 15 / Spring Y1 18 / Fall Y2 17 / Spring Y2 13-14). Catalog credit-minimum statement: 'A minimum of 63 credits are required to complete this program, which must include 30 credits of General Education Liberal Arts and Sciences, plus two different physical or wellness education courses.' (Statement sits at the end of the CS program body, after its footnotes; the adjacent '62 credits' statement belongs to Computer Networking & Cybersecurity and the '61 credits' statement to the preceding program.) Sequence term totals sum to 63-64: the Spring Year 2 Science Elective is listed as 3-4 credits; 3 credits used as the published minimum so the sequence total (63) matches the catalog degree minimum of 63. No discrepancy. The official sequence lists no per-course prerequisites, so all prereq lists are empty and external_prereqs is empty; placement details live in the catalog's course descriptions, not the sequence. Student-choice slots use choice:true with distinct placeholder codes. Either/or slots (CIS 289/INT 292; MAT 173/MAT 175) use the first option's code with options listed and the official 'or' wording preserved in the title and choice_note.
